sentences.text:
This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in relation to FIR/Crime No.247/2025 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District Ashoknagar for the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of IPC.
2.

It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that as per the prosecution allegations the complainant had alleged that co-accused Amir Khan approached the complainant on 25.07.2019 with some business proposal and as part of the said business proposal the complainant came to meet the present applicant.

Both the accused persons have stated to have taken money from the complainant in connection with the business proposal and in that manner total amount of Rs.1.97 lakhs has been taken by both the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11695 2 MCRC-24384-2025 accused persons.
It is argued that the matter relates to business transactions between the accused persons and the complainant who are well-known to each other.
The matter is of the year, 2019 and FIR has been lodged in the year, 2025.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State had vehemently opposed the bail application and had submitted that it is a case of cheating.

It is also submitted that though the FIR is against present applicant only, but in the instructions received from the concerned police station present applicant as well as Amir Khan have been informed to be accused persons.
4.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case diary,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant- Ansar Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12675678/
1 Ansar Khan be released on bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned.
